paragraphs.source_en: Matsuko's story had come to an end, but for some time, no one said a word. Perhaps unsettled by the lingering aftertaste of her lurid tale, everyone kept fidgeting and looking at each other awkwardly. Eventually, Tachibana leaned forward and said, "So you're saying that the one who committed these recent murders is Kikuno."
